page.title: Your invitation
page.description: Fill in the details, pick the design and share a single link: anyone who opens it can reply without creating an account.

loadError: We couldn't load the invitation. Reload the page and try again.

save.blocked: Not saved: pick a valid, free link in “Share”

fill.filled: We've filled in what's already in your plan. What you change here is never overwritten.
fill.canFill: Empty fields can be filled in from your plan.
fill.upToDate: Your invitation is already up to date with your plan.
fill.updated_one: {{count}} field was updated from your plan.
fill.updated_other: {{count}} fields were updated from your plan.

couple.title: The couple
couple.messageHint: A few words for your guests.

when.title: When
when.deadlineHint: After that date, the reply form closes.

where.title: Where
where.note: Anything you leave blank won't appear on the invitation.
where.name: Venue
where.mapHint: If left empty, “Get directions” will search for the address on Google Maps.
where.mapError: Paste a web address that starts with http:// or https://.

gift.title: Gift
gift.label: Show the gift details
gift.helpList: Your guests will see the list of things you've saved in your plan (without what you already have).
gift.helpMoney: Your guests will see the IBAN or Bizum you've saved in your plan.
gift.emptyList: Your gift list has nothing to show yet.
gift.emptyMoney: You haven't added an IBAN or Bizum yet.
gift.notShown: You have a gift set up, but it isn't marked to appear on the invitation.
gift.notChosen: You haven't chosen how to receive gifts yet (money or a list of things).

share.title: Publish and share
share.draftNote: It's a draft for now: nobody can see it until you publish it.
share.publishedNote: Anyone with the link can view it and reply. Whatever you change from now on shows up at the link straight away.

unpublish.question: Unpublish the invitation? The link will stop working for your guests.

slug.label: Custom link
slug.help: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores (_) only, {{min}} to {{max}} characters. It applies when you leave the field.
slug.invalid: The link must be {{min}} to {{max}} characters long, with lowercase letters, numbers or _ only.
slug.taken: This link is already in use. Try another one.
slug.error: We couldn't check it right now; we'll check it when saving.
slug.mine: This is your invitation's current link
slug.moves: If you change it, the previous link will stop working: share the new one. The replies you have already received are kept.

preview.caption: Live preview
preview.aria: Preview: the invitation on an envelope, with the thank-you card on top
preview.shared: Style and palette are shared with “Save the date”.
